1.consolidated_definition: Se dice por todo el país del café que resulta más denso y tinto por haberse empleado mayor cantidad de harina al colarlo.
1.en_consolidated_definition: This coffee is said throughout the country to be denser and darker in color due to a greater amount of flour being used when it is filtered.
